# M72 P2′ stage 1 — fused TQ4 dequantize into a per-layer scratch + MLX fused SDPA (GENERATED by `benchmark/spikes/m72_p2s_report.py`; never hand-edit)

MLX 0.32.4, Apple M5 Max `applegpu_g17s`; fork `608e33ac` (dirty: none); per full-attention layer, 24 q / 4 kv heads, head dim 256, bf16 queries, synthetic K/V, caches preallocated to 262,144 tokens; one 512-token chunk ending at T; medians; mean of passes p2s-1, p2s-2. Prototype `dev/m72_scratch_prefill.py`: scratch dtype float16; thread mapping: one thread per (KV head, token, packed uint32 word = 8 dims); a simdgroup = one token row (coalesced 128-byte reads, 512-byte fp16 writes per operand); grid (T * 32, n_kv), threadgroup 256; codebook: both fp32 codebooks staged in threadgroup memory as fp32 (16 + 16 floats), read as fp32 at the multiply.

Timed-arm order per checkpoint: p2s-1 native16_fused_v1 → tq4_production → p1_rotated_bf16 → p2s → p2s_dequant_only; p2s-2 p2s_dequant_only → p2s → p1_rotated_bf16 → tq4_production → native16_fused_v1.

## 3. Prefill-time projection for `Qwen3.8-27B-Fable-Distill-OptiQ-4.5bpw-mixed` (vs its shipped native16 + fused_v1)

attn_X(N) = Σ_j interp(X, 512·j) / 1000 s over the sub-cap checkpoints [8192, 32768, 131072, 196608, 260096] (linear extrapolation below the first); append = the 260096 checkpoint's KV append per 512-token chunk (TQ4 0.28 ms, native16 0.18 ms); fixed = prefill_s(N) − 16 · attn_native16(N) − 16 · (N/512) · append_native16; t_X(N) = fixed + 16 · attn_X(N) + 16 · (N/512) · append_X. × = prefill_s(N) / t_X(N) (speed relative to native16 shipped).
